verdict.rationale: WorkOS's AuthKit SDKs document session management, automatic token refresh and session validation, which covers the refresh part of the story and implies session handling. Nothing in the pack documents configurable session expiry or immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session. missing for 10: documented session expiry/timeout configuration, server-side session revocation API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage session lifecycle — expiry, refresh, and immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session

citations.quote: Handles sign-in, sign-up, token refresh, and session management via a hosted OAuth flow.
Session validation, automatic token refresh, PKCE sign-in, route protection
provides convenient helpers for authentication and session management using WorkOS & AuthKit with Next.js
includes helpers for common WorkOS flows such as AuthKit, SSO, webhooks, sessions, JWKS, PKCE, and Vault local crypto.
